title: Chapter 725 - 725 Threats; Hate!
content:
Chapter 725 - 725 Threats; Hate!

Chapter 725 - 725 Threats; Hate!

725 Threats; Hate!

Her own child was locked in a cage.

Furthermore, he wanted her to eat dog food?!

This evil woman, she… How dare he!

“Boom!”

A thunderclap exploded, as if the sky had been torn into pieces. The dazzling lightning illuminated Li Ke’s sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes.

The old woman slowly raised her head to look at the sky.

It was also at this moment that she happened to see Li Ke who suddenly appeared behind her.

“Ah!”

“Who are you? Why are you here?”

The old woman was so frightened that she almost fell to the ground. She stretched out her fat finger and poked at Li Ke’s face.

“Humph!”

Li Ke grunted and broke the old woman’s fingers.

“Ah!”

Instantly, the entire scene was filled with screams that sounded like pigs being slaughtered.

Bean-sized beads of sweat rolled down the old woman’s forehead.

“You’re done for! I’m telling you, you’re done for!” she shouted ferociously. No matter who you are, how dare you break my fingers? You’re finished for life!”

“Really?” Li Ke said coldly. Do you know who I am? My name is Li Ke.”

The old woman’s bean-sized eyes suddenly shrank as she cried out in fear,””Li Ke? No, no, no. Impossible, didn’t you die a long time ago?”

“I’m sorry to disappoint you, but I’m still alive!”Li Ke said indifferently.

At this moment, the little girl in the cage called out softly,”Daddy…”

Then, his body went limp and he fainted.

“Xiao Qin!” Li Ke panicked.

This evil woman!

His heart was filled with endless anger towards the old woman in front of him, and he slapped her hard on the head.

“Bang!”

Instantly, the old woman’s head exploded like a watermelon, and blood spurted out.

Then, Li Ke pulled hard with his palm.

The heavy cage was like a bubble, directly deformed and shattered.

Li Ke carefully held Xiao Qin in his arms and continued to transfer life energy.

After a while, Xiao Qin opened her eyes.

She said softly,”Dad…” Father.”

“I’m here, I’m here!” Li Ke hurriedly said.

“Xiao Qin, I’m so hungry.” the girl said.

“Daddy will take you to eat now.”Li Ke said.

He took a step forward and moved forward like a gust of wind.

A moment later, they arrived at a luxurious restaurant.

“Waiter, bring me all the good food and drinks here!” Li Ke said anxiously.”

The waiter was stunned for a moment.

However, he soon felt the terrifying aura coming from Li Ke’s body.

Hence, he stammered,”Yes, yes…”

Then, he hurriedly asked the chef to prepare the dishes.

The restaurant was very efficient.

In less than ten minutes, delicious dishes were served one after another.

Xiao Qin looked at the food and her small eyes were a little stunned. She could not help but swallow her saliva.

However, she did not dare to pick up her chopsticks.

“Xiao Qin, why aren’t you eating?” Li Ke asked.”

Xiao Qin said,”But… Can I eat it?”

“Of course. Eat quickly and eat as much as you want.”After Li Ke finished speaking, he took the initiative to put the food into Xiao Qin’s bowl.

Xiao Qin finally couldn’t take it anymore and stuffed the food into her mouth.

“Baji, baji!”

“Gulp, gulp!”

She ate in big mouthfuls, her small mouth bulging.

Li Ke said,”Eat slowly, don’t be anxious…” Have some soup first.”

Xiao Qin was very satisfied with the meal, and her stomach became round.

Li Ke had been watching Xiao Qin silently from the beginning to the end.

He looked at Xiao Qin’s small mouth, her eyebrows, and her chin…

The more Li Ke looked at it, the more he felt that it resembled himself and Hu Yufang.

Hu Yufang was his girlfriend back then.

That’s right!

Xiao Qin must be her and Hu Yufang’s child!

Where was Hu Yufang?

Why wasn’t she with Xiao Qin?

Why didn’t you protect Xiao Qin?

“Where’s your mother, Qin?” Li Ke asked.”

“Mommy…” Xiao Qin suddenly thought of something and said anxiously,” Mommy is in danger. Daddy, go and save Mommy!”

“Do you know where your mother is?” Li Ke’s heart tightened.”

“I… I don’t know…” Xiao Qin said.

Thus, Li Ke carried Xiao Qin and soared into the sky.

Then, with Li Ke as the center, surging Mentality spread out in all directions like a tide.

Soon, his attention was locked onto a private room in a bar.

There…A woman with a voluptuous figure was standing shakily in front of a man.

He found it!

Li Ke turned into a stream of light and moved forward rapidly.

….

In the private room of the bar.

The man in the checkered shirt sized up Hu Yufang in front of him and grinned.”You want to save your daughter? Alright! As long as you serve me well today, I can let her go tomorrow.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he reached out to touch Hu Yufang’s voluptuous figure.

Hu Yufang instinctively dodged to the side.

“Hide?” The man’s face darkened. Good!”

“I won’t move today! Move yourself! Otherwise, I can guarantee that your daughter will be very miserable!”

Hu Yufang shuddered.

She unbuttoned one of her buttons with trembling hands, revealing her plump figure.

The man’s breathing began to become heavy.

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, Li Ke suddenly appeared in the private room with Xiao Qin in his arms.

Hu Yufang looked over and said excitedly,”Xiao Qin!”

Then, he said in surprise,”You are…” Li Ke?”

“Yes, it’s me.” Li Ke nodded.

“You… Aren’t you…” Hu Yufang said in a trembling voice.

“I’m not dead. You’ve worked hard all these years.”Li Ke comforted her. As he spoke, he slowly pulled Hu Yufang into his arms.

“Mommy…” Xiao Qin said.

The family of three hugged each other, feeling extremely warm.

At this moment, a discordant voice sounded in the private room.

“Humph! Isn’t it too early for you to be happy?”

Li Ke, Hu Yufang, and Xiao Qin all looked at the man.

Hu Yufang and Xiao Qin’s faces were filled with fear.

Li Ke was icy cold.

“Li Ke, I didn’t expect you to be alive. That’s good!” the man said sternly. Later, watch me exercise with your wife first, and then die again!”

Li Ke’s expression was cold as he raised his hand and grabbed the man’s neck.

The man wanted to break free, but he seemed to have lost all his strength. His face revealed a hint of fear.

“What kind of special ability is this?”the man said in shock.

Li Ke’s face revealed a look of disdain.

Special ability?

He was already a cultivator!

Li Ke did not intend to answer. He turned to Hu Yufang and said,””Lisa, carry Xiao Qin out first. Leave this to me.”

He didn’t want them to see a bloody scene.

Hu Yufang held Xiao Qin in her arms and hesitated.

“Don’t worry, it’ll be fine. I promise that no one in this world will ever hurt you again.””

Hu Yufang nodded and slowly left.
